plan.archetype: Poison and dexterity with early direct damage
plan.bossPrep: Establish poison and dexterity, retain reliable block, and save a defensive potion for the explosion. Killing the body does not end the fight.
plan.summary: Prioritize an early shop: remove Greed and buy damage plus defense. Take selective elites only after improving damage and obtaining potions. Build poison scaling without neglecting explosion survival.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with dexterity and efficient direct damage
plan.bossPrep: Add sustained poison and upgraded defensive powers through Frozen Egg. Enter healthy; save a block potion and reliable defense for the explosion.
plan.summary: Upgrade Poisoned Stab now. Keep the two-campfire shop route. Buy poison scaling or dexterity, remove Greed, preserve defensive density, and heal before the boss as needed.

plan.archetype: Poison and Serpent Form with dexterity and efficient draw
plan.bossPrep: Establish poison and defensive powers early. Use Tears to fund Serpent Form safely; prepare Weak and sufficient block for triple attacks.
plan.summary: Prioritize lasting defense and draw around upgraded poison and Serpent Form. Use two shops to improve consistency; Greed is unremovable. Upgrade Scrawl when healthy, otherwise heal. Take only the required elite.
